snippet.title: Possessed Kingdom Trailer
snippet.description:
Defend your kingdom or rush the enemy in this Deckbuilding RTS. Build your base, scale your economy, and draw custom paths for your troops to break enemy defenses. Win battles, steal the king's cards, and build the ultimate deck.

Demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4435910/Possessed_Kingdom_Demo/
